purpose: Second, independently frozen alternative after the Doppler position-update train No-Go; evaluate only a causal observable IMU process-noise lane.

candidate.ranked_source: GSDC top-solution feasibility audit rank 2 physical GNSS/IMU direction; this is a smaller fallback and is not claimed to reproduce the published tightly coupled estimator.
candidate.implementation: causal gyro vector norm and robust acceleration-norm dynamics adjust only the process-noise multiplier of the existing constant-velocity Kalman/RTS smoother; no absolute acceleration integration, orientation, lever-arm, or future IMU sample is used

parameters.split_reset: none within each route; routes are independently processed

candidate.selection_reason: The fixed candidate was already observable-only and unit-tested; its existing single-route development result makes it the least-cost second physical alternative after Doppler, while the timing/orientation-complete coupled filter remains unavailable.

frozen_gate.train_required: each route availability, truth coverage, H WGS84 P50/P95, V P95, and all four local diagnostics must be non-regressed versus exact WLS; aggregate H P95 and four-diagnostic mean must both strictly improve
frozen_gate.fresh_validation_required: open only when train passes; same per-route non-regression and aggregate strict improvements
frozen_gate.future_holdout_required: open only when fresh validation passes; one truth read, no post-holdout tuning or rerun
frozen_gate.diagnostic_formula_status: four local public-spec variants only; official hidden distance/percentile details remain undetermined

commands.truth_scoring: existing smoother metric implementation, replayed only after all train truth-free artifacts are hash sealed

limitations: This fallback adjusts smoother covariance but does not estimate GNSS/IMU timestamp offset or solve a tightly coupled factor graph.
No map asset, orientation calibration, lever-arm calibration, or base-station stream is introduced.
If train gate fails, fresh validation and future holdout remain unopened.
